title: One-Page Map — Whole Act on One Screen
description:
A clearer, optional whole-act map view: the vanilla map's own vertical layout, compressed so every node of the act fits on one screen — same rooms, same connections, same art style.

Your current spot, legal next moves, and past route are all called out, with the game's own legend, icons, dashed footpaths, and per-act colours. Room icons stay full-strength: future rooms wear a band of their type colour, legal destinations pulse with a white border (thicker on hover), and clicking one travels via the game's own selection path. An optional toggle (off by default) fades rooms you can no longer reach.

Map drawings work on the flat page too (draw / erase / clear, same tools and shortcuts as classic). Quest markers such as Fur Coat / Spoils Map show the same red X as vanilla.

Visibility only: One-Page Map does not change cards, routes, travel rules, combat, rewards, saves, or any other gameplay.

Controls: M toggles the map, F flips flat/classic while a map is up, ESC/back leaves. Three on-map checkboxes (Flat map, Compress, Hide unreachable nodes) persist across runs. Mouse, keyboard, and controller supported.

Targets STS2 v0.110.1.
changeNote: 0.4.0 — Flat map now supports vanilla map drawings (draw/erase/clear + right/middle-click) with tools placed clear of the checkboxes; Fur Coat / Spoils Map quest markers; act-start banner; first-run room-select FTUE; top-bar map button oscillation while open.
